title: Beginner Hiking Guide Printable PDF, How to Start Hiking, First Hike Checklist, Day Hike Planner, Gift for New Hiker, Outdoor Beginner Guide
description:
Twelve short chapters that take you from "I've never really hiked" to planning and finishing your own day hikes with confidence. No filler, no gear lists you can't afford, no talking down to you.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- Before You Start
- Choosing Your First Trail
- Understanding Difficulty: what "moderate" really means
- Reading the Weather
- What to Wear
- What to Pack
- Water and Food
- Navigation
- Staying Safe
- Trail Etiquette
- When Something Goes Wrong
- Your First Hike Checklist

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions, print-ready
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Written for people who own nothing yet: the guide says clearly what to buy later and what to skip. General information for day hikers; always check local conditions before you go. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable guides at hikesupplyco.com
